reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 0, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: An arrow faces UP. It does a quarter turn clockwise. Which direction does it face now?
An arrow faces UP. It does a quarter turn clockwise. Which direction does it face now?
An arrow faces UP. It does a quarter turn counter-clockwise. Which direction does it face now?
An arrow faces UP. It does a quarter turn clockwise. Which direction does it face now?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Four of five samples correctly test quarter-turn position identification, e.g. seed 45's 'It does a quarter turn counter-clockwise. Which direction does it face now?' resolving to left, but the competency explicitly names 'half turn OR...quarter turn' and no sample anywhere in the five seeds tests a half turn.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: 'Half turn', an explicitly named sub-case in the competency wording, has zero representation across all five seeds; only quarter-turn scenarios and one turns-vocabulary definition question, seed 44, are generated.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The two-sentence stem 'An arrow faces UP. It does a quarter turn clockwise. Which direction does it face now?' is concrete and short, appropriate for Grade 1 Quarter 4 spatial reasoning.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The starting direction is always 'UP' in every one of the five samples -- the competency specifies 'given an initial facing direction', implying the initial direction itself should vary, but only the turn direction, clockwise vs counter-clockwise, ever changes.

competency_alignment.rationale: Seed 44's 'Which direction is clockwise?' tests rote definitional vocabulary recall rather than the applied 'identify resulting position after a turn' skill the other four samples correctly target, varying a knowledge-recall axis instead of the named spatial-transformation axis.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The four cardinal directions, up, down, left, right, used throughout are the complete and correct scale for a Grade 1 Quarter 4 quarter-turn competency.
